# Datavideo NVS-33 1.0.0

First public release of the Bitfocus Companion module for the **Datavideo NVS-33 H.264 streaming encoder and recorder**. It drives the device over the same JSON/HTTP interface its own web UI uses: streaming, recording, encoder settings, stream server targets, inputs, audio and the production functions of the Datavideo API.

**43 actions · 10 feedbacks · 30 variables · 24 presets**

## Highlights

- Automatic login with the device digest scheme (`md5(user:myrealm:password)`), and transparent re-login when the session drops.
- Safe property writes: each setting is read back and merged, so changing one value never resets the rest of the block.
- The password is a Companion secret, so it never appears in exported configurations.
- Adjustable polling, or polling disabled and state refreshed on demand from a button.
- Presets grouped into sections: Streaming, Recording, Record to card, Input and audio, Encoder, Production, Device.

## Actions (43)

**Streaming — 6**
`Streaming: Start` · `Streaming: Stop` · `Streaming: Toggle` · `Streaming: Link YouTube account` · `Streaming: Link Facebook account` · `Streaming: Unlink YouTube / Facebook`

**Encoder — 6**
`Encoder: Set video bitrate` (44–65536 kbps) · `Set resolution` (128–1920 × 64–1080) · `Set frame rate` (1–60 fps) · `Set GOP` · `Set H.264 profile` (Baseline / Main / High) · `Set audio bitrate` (32–384 kbps)

**Stream server targets — 6**
`RTSP: Set server properties` (ports, account, stream name, multicast) · `RTMP: Set publish target` (URL, stream key, credentials) · `TS: Set output address` · `HLS: Set video only` · `HLS: Enable or disable preview` · `SRT: Set listener port`

**Recording — 4**
`Recording: Start` · `Recording: Stop` · `Recording: Toggle` · `Recording: Set file properties` (name, container AVI / MP4 / TS / MOV, segment length)

**Inputs — 4**
`Input: Select video source` (Composite, S-Video, HDMI, DVI, YPbPr, VGA, SDI, Photo, IP stream, file) · `Input: Use IP stream source` · `Input: Show picture` · `Input: Play file`

**Audio — 3**
`Audio: Select input` (Embedded, RCA / line-in, XLR, microphone) · `Audio: Set line-in volume` · `Audio: Adjust line-in volume`

**Video — 2**
`Video: Set picture tuning` (brightness, contrast, hue, saturation, sharpness) · `Video: Set mirroring`

**Production (multi-channel models) — 9**
`PGM: Set layout` · `PGM: Set channel position` · `Monitor: Select output` · `Monitor: Set output frame rate` · `Monitor: Set output volume` · `OSD: Set text overlay` · `OSD: Show or hide layer` · `Snapshot: Capture` · `Mixer: Set channel volume`

**Device — 3**
`Device: Set device name` · `Device: Reboot` · `Device: Refresh state now`

## Feedbacks (10)

Streaming is active (per stream and protocol) · Any streaming is active · Recording is active (per recording) · Any recording is active · Video input is selected · Audio input is selected · Input signal is detected · PGM layout is active · Monitor output is active · HLS preview is enabled

## Variables (30)

- Streaming: `streaming_main_status`, `streaming_main_type`, `streaming_sub_status`, `streaming_sub_type`
- Recording: `recording_main_status`, `recording_sub_status`, `recording_main_file`, `recording_sub_file`
- Inputs: `video_source`, `audio_source`, `input_signal`, `input_resolution`, `input_framerate`, `input_scan`, `input_audio`
- Production: `pgm_type`, `pgm_scale`, `multiview_type`, `hls_preview`, `monitor_volume_multiview`, `monitor_volume_pgm`
- Encoder: `encoder_main_bitrate`, `encoder_main_resolution`, `encoder_main_framerate`, `encoder_sub_bitrate`
- Device: `storage_capacity`, `storage_remaining`, `device_name`, `firmware_version`, `software_version`

## Presets (24)

- Streaming: RTMP / RTSP / HLS / SRT on-off for the main stream, stop all streams.
- Recording: main recording on-off, start, stop.
- Inputs and audio: SDI, HDMI, embedded audio, RCA / line-in, volume up, volume down.
- Encoder: 8000 / 4000 / 1500 kbps.
- Production: PGM full screen, PIP, PBP; monitor multiview, monitor PGM.
- Device: refresh state, reboot.

## Configuration

| Field                    | Default                                |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| Device address           | `192.168.1.60`                         |
| HTTP port                | `80`                                   |
| Username / password      | `admin` / `0000` (stored as a secret)  |
| Device channel (`/_devN`) | `0`                                   |
| Poll interval            | `3000 ms` (`0` disables polling)       |

## Scope and limitations

- The NVS-33 is a single-channel encoder. The production actions belong to the Datavideo API and are aimed at multi-channel models; on an NVS-33 they may answer with an error, which is logged without dropping the connection.
- Deliberately not exposed: network reconfiguration, firmware update, account changes, storage formatting, factory reset.
- The module has been exercised against a simulated NVS-33 endpoint, not yet against physical hardware.

## Compatibility

Built for the `node26` Companion module runtime with `@companion-module/base` 2.1.3.

## Protocol

Implements the Datavideo HTTP JSON command interface (`HTTP.COMMAND.APPS.txt` and `HTTP.COMMAND.SYSTEN.txt`, v1.4.0), documented by Datavideo. MIT licensed.
